title: Figure and explanation
description: The title, a figure column (a figure, its caption, a legend) and an explanation column that builds up beside it, one block under the other. Stacks on narrow screens, figure first.

balance.description: figure: a wider figure column; activity: a wider explanation column, for an activity next to the figure.

figure.description: column: the figure's blocks one under the other; stack: drawn over each other in one square frame, for a figure built in steps (an image with its caption first, then the layers each step adds).
